Shares now trade on the TSX Venture Exchange, the OTCQB Venture Market and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange as TruSilver advances drilling at its Sturgis-Walton Silver Project in Nova Scotia

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - TruSilver Metals Corp. (TSXV: TAG) (OTCQB: TAGMF) (FSE: XJ10) ("TruSilver" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its common shares have been approved for trading on the OTCQB® Venture Market, operated by OTC Markets Group Inc., and commenced trading under the symbol "TAGMF" on November 27, 2026. The Company's common shares will continue to trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "TAG".

The OTCQB is a U.S. trading venue for entrepreneurial and development-stage companies. To qualify, companies must be current in their reporting and pass an annual verification and management certification process. The listing gives U.S. investors a simple way to buy and hold TruSilver shares through their existing brokerage accounts, in U.S. dollars and during U.S. market hours.

Highlights

  • Three markets in one month. TruSilver began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on October 27, 2026, on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange on November 10, 2026 (FSE: XJ10; WKN: A42QTR), and now on the OTCQB.

  • Broader investor reach. The OTCQB listing opens TruSilver to U.S. retail and institutional investors, alongside its existing Canadian and European shareholder base.

  • Drilling at Sturgis-Walton. TruSilver's planned 2026/27 diamond drilling program of approximately 3,500 metres across five holes is commencing with hole ST-26-01A at its 100%-owned Sturgis-Walton Silver Project, adjacent to the historic Walton Mine.

Michael Gross, President and Chief Executive Officer of TruSilver, commented:

"Adding the OTCQB means investors in Canada, Europe and the United States can now own TruSilver on a market close to home. The U.S. has one of the deepest pools of capital for silver and precious-metals explorers anywhere, and we want those investors following our story from the start. That story is about to be tested with the drill. Sturgis-Walton sits next to one of the historic highest-grade silver mines in Nova Scotia's history, and our geophysics points to a target at depth that has never been properly drilled. Over the coming months our job is simple: drill it, report what we find, and keep our shareholders informed every step of the way."

U.S. investors can find current financial disclosure and Real-Time Level 2 quotes for the Company on www.otcmarkets.com. Canadian disclosure documents, including the Company's filing statement dated October 15, 2026 and the independent NI 43-101 technical report on the Sturgis-Walton Silver Project effective October 7, 2026, are available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

About TruSilver Metals Corp.

TruSilver Metals Corp. owns 100% of the Sturgis-Walton Silver Project in Hants County, Nova Scotia, free of a net smelter return royalty, adjacent to the historic Walton Mine, a past barite producer and silver-rich lead-zinc-copper mine, where historical sources report mined ore head grades of 350-933 g/t silver (Ag).¹ TruSilver is commencing drilling of hole ST-26-01A, the first hole of its 2026/27 drill program, aimed squarely at the Sturgis Target: a large, dense and electrically conductive body approximately 1.5 km south of the Walton Mine. The Sturgis Target is where five years of magnetic, audio-magnetotelluric (AMT) and gravity surveys, drilling and 3D modelling converge. The Company's working hypothesis, which this program is designed to test, is that the Sturgis Target may represent a somewhat deeper and along-strike part of the same mineralizing system that formed the Walton Mine. A drilling permit is in place. TruSilver's 2023 hole, ST-23-001 (collared approximately 850 m from the mine), was drilled between the Walton Mine and the newer Sturgis Target, and returned 48.8 g/t silver and 0.19% copper over 19.0 metres in the Macumber Formation, the rock unit that hosted mineralization at the Walton Mine, potentially indicating distal lower-grade mineralization between the two zones.² In late 2025, Rio Tinto Exploration Canada Inc. staked all open mineral claims in the Minas sub-basin, comprising 2,363 claims under 30 exploration licences, surrounding the Sturgis-Walton Silver Project. Rio Tinto is not affiliated with TruSilver, and its activities are not indicative of mineralization on TruSilver's property.

TruSilver's team combines decades of exploration, mine-development and capital-markets experience, with current or former lead technical and board roles at IAMGOLD, Noranda-Falconbridge, Glencore, Sherritt International and Sibanye-Stillwater. Team members contributed to the discovery or acquisition of over 30 million ounces of gold and led the completion and initial ramp-up of a US$7 billion nickel project.

For more information and to sign up for news releases, visit www.TruSilverMetals.com.

The silver grades are a range of historical head grades reported for ore mined at the Walton Mine, not a single verified average production grade. Neither the Technical Report's author nor TruSilver's Qualified Person has independently verified these historical production figures, and they should not be relied upon. The Walton Mine is not owned by TruSilver, and mineralization on adjacent properties is not necessarily indicative of mineralization on TruSilver's property. No mineral resource has been estimated.

Tirzepatide and GLP3 become the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach production, 100% tested and manufactured in the United States by a single manufacturer producing exclusively for the Company; full lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027

Highlights

  • 20,000 tirzepatide and 20,000 GLP3 patches ordered after both passed formal U.S. testing, the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order
  • The Recovery Patch (BPC-157) is on sale now; 20,000 Thymosin Alpha-1 patches ordered for January 2027 delivery; tirzepatide and GLP3 ordered today; full needle-free lineup targeted for sale by Q1 2027
  • Both are GLP-1 category patches, aimed at a global GLP-1 market valued at approximately US$66 billion in 2025 and projected to reach US$185.3 billion by 2033[2,3]
  • 100% tested and manufactured in the United States, by one U.S. manufacturer, with every patch produced solely for the Company under exclusive manufacturing rights
  • No needle, no mixing, no measuring, no refrigeration

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - The Precision Peptide Company (CSE: BPC) (OTCQB: PNGAF) (the "Company"), a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, today announced that its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches have each passed formal U.S. testing and that it has ordered 20,000 units of each from its exclusive U.S. manufacturer. They are the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order, following BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1, and the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the first quarter of 2027, up from the single patch on sale today.

The tirzepatide patch was announced as under development on August 19, 2026 and entered formal U.S. testing on October 13, 2026. The GLP3 patch entered development on October 20, 2026. Both are in the Company's metabolic and weight-management category, and both have now passed the same U.S. testing stage that the Company's BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1 ("TA1") patches passed before their own production orders.

100% Tested and Manufactured in the United States

Every patch in the line follows the same production and testing process: formulated in the United States, tested in the United States by an independent laboratory, produced in the United States, then released. The first patch through that process, The Recovery Patch (BPC-157), recorded 95.5% chromatographic purity and a quantified 2.02 mg dose per patch in independent laboratory testing, exceeding the 95% threshold widely used as the benchmark for high-purity peptide products.

TA1 followed with a 20,000-unit order at 2 mg per patch. Tirzepatide and GLP3 have now cleared the same stage. All four formulations are produced by one U.S. manufacturer solely for the Company under the exclusive manufacturing rights announced on October 22, 2026, so that one testing standard and one production standard apply across the whole line.

The Needle-Free Line at a Glance

BPC-157 (The Recovery Patch)On saleIndependent U.S. laboratory testing recorded 95.5% purity and a 2.02 mg dose per patch (May 19, 2026); approximately 20,000 units received July 2026 (July 14, 2026); available at store.precisionpep.co
Thymosin Alpha-1 (TA1)In productionEntered formal U.S. testing September 2026; 20,000 units ordered October 2026 at 2 mg per patch, delivery expected January 2027 (October 7, 2026)
TirzepatideIn productionDevelopment announced August 2026 (August 19, 2026); entered formal U.S. testing October 2026 (October 13, 2026); testing passed; 20,000 units ordered November 2026
GLP3In productionDevelopment announced October 2026 (October 20, 2026); formal U.S. testing passed; 20,000 units ordered November 2026
MOTS-cIn developmentDevelopment announced November 26, 2026

 

A Full Line by Q1 2027

The Recovery Patch, on sale since July 2026, was the first product in the Company's needle-free range. With 20,000-unit orders now placed for TA1, tirzepatide and GLP3, the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the end of the first quarter of 2027. Each patch will be sold through the Company's direct-to-consumer website and its wholesale program for clinics, medical spas, gyms and retailers in all 50 U.S. states.

No Needle, No Mixing, No Refrigeration

Injectable peptides, including the Company's own prescription vials, are typically supplied as a powder that must be mixed with sterile water, measured into a syringe, injected and kept refrigerated. The Company's patches remove those steps. The Company's patches are applied to the skin, and each patch delivers a pre-measured dose: no needle, no mixing, no measuring, no cold storage. Discreet, portable and consistent from one dose to the next, they fit into a daily routine and open peptides to the many people who were interested but prefer not to use a syringe.

Market Context

Tirzepatide and GLP3 are the Company's two patches in the metabolic and weight-management category. The global GLP-1 market was valued at approximately US$66 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach US$185.3 billion by 2033,[2,3] with injectable delivery accounting for 69.1% of the market in 2025.[2] The broader global peptide therapeutics market was valued at US$56.06 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach US$87.21 billion by 2035, with North America the largest regional market.[1] The Company believes that U.S.-based development, testing and manufacturing, combined with a needle-free format, position it to compete as those markets expand.

The foregoing market data is provided as context for the Company's product development activities and should not be construed as a projection of the Company's future revenue or market share.

Pratap Sandhu, CEO of The Precision Peptide Company, commented:

"We are making significant progress in turning our needle-free patches into a commercial product portfolio. In just four months, we have grown from one patch on sale to three additional patches ordered for production, including 40,000 tirzepatide and GLP3 patches following successful U.S. testing. Our exclusive U.S. manufacturing partnership gives us a strong foundation to expand production while maintaining consistent quality standards. We are targeting commercial availability of all four patches by March 2027, with MOTS-c now also in development as our fifth. Our priority is clear: accelerate commercialization, expand our product portfolio and establish The Precision Peptide Company as a leader in needle-free peptide delivery."

St. Lewis, Newfoundland and Labrador--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Search Minerals Inc. (TSXV: SMY) (OTC Pink: SHCMF) ("Search Minerals" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has entered into a binding term sheet (the "Term Sheet") with certain lenders (the "Lenders"), including two of the Company's largest shareholders, Petra Holdings Company Inc. ("Petra") and Harder Investments Ltd. ("Harder"), for the Lenders to provide the Company a C$1.4 million secured convertible loan (the "Loan"). The proceeds from the Loan will be primarily used to repay the Company's C$700,000 principal amount convertible note issued to Texas Critical Minerals, LLC ("TCM") in October 2024, which matured on October 25, 2025, together with all accrued interest.

The principal amount of the Loan will mature and be repayable in full on the date which is three years from closing, and will be convertible into common shares at the option of the Lenders at any time prior to the close of business on the maturity date at a conversion price of $0.30 per share. The principal amount of the Loan will bear interest at 8.5% per annum, payable annually on December 31, commencing December 31, 2027. Subject to the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV"), Search will have the option to pay interest in common shares in lieu of cash at the market price for the common shares at the time the interest becomes payable. Any conversion that would result in a Lender becoming a Control Person (as defined in the policies of the TSXV) will be subject to prior TSXV approval, including shareholder approval. The Loan will be secured by a pledge of the shares of the Company's subsidiaries Alterra Resources Inc. and 86857 Newfoundland & Labrador Inc., together with guarantees and personal property security granted by those subsidiaries.

Upon completion, the transaction is expected to:

  • Lower interest rate costs: reduce the interest rate on the TCM note being repaid from 15% to 8.5%;
  • Reduce TCM's claims: resolve the claim TCM has filed against the Company relating to the note, one of three claims filed by TCM against the Company as disclosed in the Company's financial statements. With respect to the two remaining claims, the Company continues to dispute the amounts alleged to be owing, believes it has credible defences, and intends to defend its position while remaining focused on advancing its core projects and protecting shareholder interests; and
  • Improve working capital: remove past-due debt owed to TCM from the Company's working capital deficit, subject to final accounting treatment, by extending the maturity dates for the Company's debt and treating such liability as non-current, and provide funds for general working capital.

Jonathan Beigle, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Search Minerals, commented: "We appreciate the continued support of our largest shareholders. This financing allows us to repay the TCM note, lower our interest costs and extend maturities. This will allow us to focus all of our effort on advancing our projects for the benefit of all shareholders."

Closing of the transaction is expected in mid-December, 2026. The Term Sheet is a preliminary binding agreement; completion of the transaction remains subject to, among other things, negotiation and execution of definitive documentation, approval of the Company's Board of Directors and a special committee of independent directors, acceptance of the TSXV, and satisfaction of customary conditions. There can be no assurance that the transaction will be completed on the terms described or at all.

The Loan, and any common shares issued on conversion of the Loan, will be subject to a hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance of the Loan, in accordance with applicable securities legislation and TSXV policies. Any common shares issued in payment of interest will be subject to a hold period of four months and one day from their date of issuance.

Petra is controlled by Michael Pearson, a director of the Company, and Petra also owns more than 10% of the voting securities of the Company. Accordingly, Petra is a "related party" of the Company. Harder owns more than 10% of the voting securities of the Company. Accordingly, Harder is also a "related party" of the Company. As a result, the transaction is a related party transaction subject to Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101"). The transaction is exempt from the formal valuation requirements of MI 61-101 pursuant to subsection 5.5(b) of MI 61-101 because the Company's common Shares are listed only on the TSXV and is exempt from the minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 pursuant to subsection 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 because neither the fair market value of the subject matter of, nor the fair market value of the consideration for, the transaction, insofar as it involves interested parties, exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization as determined in accordance with MI 61-101.

ABOUT SEARCH MINERALS

Led by a proven management team and board of directors, Search is focused on finding and developing Critical Rare Earth Elements (CREE), Zirconium (Zr) and Hafnium (Hf) resources within the emerging Port Hope Simpson - St. Lewis CREE District of southeast Labrador. The Company controls a belt 64 km long and 2 km wide that is road accessible, on tidewater, and located near three local communities. The Company has completed a preliminary economic assessment report with resource estimates for Foxtrot and Deep Fox. It is also working on four exploration prospects along the belt: Fox Meadow, Silver Fox, Fox Run and Awesome Fox.

The Company has completed two pilot plant operations and produced highly purified mixed rare earth carbonate concentrate and mixed REO concentrate for separation and refining.

At launch, developers will be able to use data from past agent runs to compare commercial cloud models, Apple's on-device foundation models and models running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute, and open-weight models hosted on private or sovereign infrastructure.

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Railtown AI Technologies Inc. (CSE: RAIL) (OTCQB: RLAIF) ("Railtown" or the "Company") today announced new on-demand model evaluation capabilities that use data captured from actual agent runs to compare alternative AI models. The technology extends Railtown's agent observability capabilities and helps developers and enterprises assess whether a lower-cost model or a different deployment environment can meet an application's quality and reliability requirements.

Evaluating Models Against Real Application Workloads

Railtown's agent observability technology can run locally or through its Conductr cloud platform, giving developers visibility into agent execution across development and production environments. The new capabilities use historical execution data to evaluate alternative models against real application workloads.

Developers can use these evaluations to identify tasks that may run on smaller, more efficient models, assess whether suitable workloads can move to a device or privately controlled infrastructure, and reduce reliance on any one provider. As new models become available, teams can revisit model choices throughout an application's life.

Evaluating Models in Apple's AI Ecosystem

Combining the new evaluation capabilities with Railtown's open-source Railtracks Swift Agent Development Kit (ADK) and agent observability gives Apple developers a way to assess which workloads could run on Apple's on-device foundation models or on a model running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute, where available.

Moving suitable tasks to an on-device model can reduce external inference costs, keep those model requests on the device and enable offline functionality where supported. Eligible developers can also evaluate Apple's cloud-hosted model for tasks that need more reasoning capacity or a larger context window.

"Developers should be able to look at the work their agents already do and ask where a smaller model can deliver the quality they need," said Marwan Haddad, CTO and Co-Founder of Railtown AI. "For an Apple developer, that might mean moving part of a workflow onto the device. For an enterprise, it might mean running a model on infrastructure it controls. In both cases, the decision starts with data from the application itself."

Supporting Private and Sovereign AI Deployments

Enterprises and governments seeking greater control over sensitive data and intellectual property can use the technology to assess whether open-weight models running on infrastructure they control meet the requirements of existing applications.

In Canada, Railtown sees an opportunity to complement investment in sovereign AI infrastructure by helping organizations identify which workloads can move to domestically controlled computing environments and what changes those workloads may require.

The new capabilities extend Railtown's agent development tools, which include the open-source Railtracks Swift and Python ADKs, knowledge retrieval technology, agent observability and the Conductr platform. The Company is also exploring ways to build on its observability and evaluation technology to help developers optimize prompts and agent workflows.

Railtown expects to make the evaluation capabilities available to developers soon and plans to publish a technical blog demonstrating how to use them.

About Railtown AI Technologies Inc.

Railtown AI Technologies Inc. is an AI technology company developing tools and infrastructure that enable developers and organizations to build, deploy, manage and observe AI-powered applications and agents.

Its technology includes Conductr, an agentic AI orchestration, deployment and observability platform; Railengine, its knowledge and data infrastructure; and Railtracks, its open-source Agent Development Kit.

Railtown is focused on simplifying the development and operation of agentic applications while supporting organizations seeking flexible, secure and scalable AI solutions.

Topics expected to be discussed include:

  • Fast-charging battery results (October 8): Testing at the Battery Innovation Center of Indiana showed an energy density of 58 Wh/kg with six-minute charging, up 48% from 39 Wh/kg. GMG also reported 94% energy efficiency and, in a separate cycling test, no measurable performance loss after 1,000 cycles.
  • First G®CELLS customer samples (October 21): GMG began shipping 1.5 Ah pouch cells designed for six-minute charging to potential customers for evaluation, including in the defence and heavy mobile equipment sectors.
  • European distribution agreement (November 4): GMG signed an exclusive distribution agreement with Brenntag Química S.A.U. covering Spain, Italy and Portugal initially. Brenntag will focus first on G® LUBRICANT through its existing lubricant distribution network while developing opportunities for G® FLUID and THERMAL-XR®.
  • G® LUBRICANT distribution in Mexico (November 12): GMG named GrafnoMex its exclusive distributor in Mexico for G® LUBRICANT, a graphene engine oil additive. GrafnoMex reported lower fuel consumption and emissions in local tests on heavy-duty diesel trucks.
  • UK battery manufacturing (November 19): GMG signed an initial service agreement with the UK Battery Industrialisation Centre to manufacture larger-format G®CELLS in Coventry using battery materials produced at GMG's development centre in Brisbane.
  • Gen 2.0 graphene plant quality progress (November 25): GMG made crucial quality progress at the new, higher production rate of its Gen 2.0 graphene manufacturing plant, which is expected to produce 10 tonnes of graphene per annum once fully completed and optimised.

About GMG

GMG is an Australian based clean-technology company which develops, makes and sells energy saving and energy storage solutions, enabled by graphene manufactured via in house production process. GMG uses its own proprietary production process to decompose natural gas (i.e. methane) into its natural elements, carbon (as graphene), hydrogen and some residual hydrocarbon gases. This process produces high quality, low cost, scalable, 'tuneable' and low/no contaminant graphene suitable for use in clean-technology and other applications.

The Company's present focus is to de-risk and develop commercial scale-up capabilities, and secure market applications. In the energy savings segment, GMG has initially focused on graphene enhanced heating, ventilation and air conditioning ("HVAC-R") coating (or energy-saving coating) which is now being marketed into other applications including electronic heat sinks, industrial process plants and data centres. Another product GMG has developed is the graphene lubricant additive focused on saving liquid fuels initially for diesel engines.

In the energy storage segment, GMG and the University of Queensland are working collaboratively with financial support from the Australian Government to progress R&D and commercialisation of GMG Graphene Batteries. GMG has also developed a graphene additive slurry that is aimed at improving the performance of lithium-ion batteries.

The Company has named this the Starry Night Mine ("Starry Night") and intends to prioritise sampling work there as part of its next phase of fieldwork in the coming weeks.

Starry Night Mine

Starry Night was identified by the Company's technical team during recent reconnaissance work at Defender and initial field observations, including shortwave ultraviolet ("SWUV") inspection, have identified approximately 50m of scheelite-bearing garnet skarn mineralisation along the adit.

As announced on 7 July 2026, it is theorised that a 3km skarn trend extends from the Defender Mine through the Pine Crow and Widowmaker Mines to the Company's JORC-compliant M2 skarn copper resource. As described in the Company's announcement of 18 August 2026, the Project comprises the historical Widowmaker, Pine Crow, Dough God and Defender tungsten mines, located along a >2km mineralised corridor within the total 3km mineralised trend running from Defender to the M2 resource.

Located west of Widowmaker, Starry Night has the potential to extend the Project's tungsten strike from approximately 2km to approximately 2.4km and lies along the 3km trend linking the Project to the M2 resource 600m away.

The Company intends to prioritise channel sampling at Starry Night and further updates will reported as results are received.

Figure 1: Location of the Starry Night Mine and extension of identified strike towards the M2 copper resource in the west.

Drill Assays and Maiden Mineral Resource Estimate

As announced on 23 September 2026, the Company completed a 23-hole reverse circulation drilling programme for approximately 8,500 ft (2,590 m) at Defender, with all samples dispatched to American Assay in Reno, Nevada. Assay results were expected in Q4 2026 however processing has since been delayed by laboratory capacity constraints affecting the region, and results are still outstanding.

Addison Mining Services ("Addison"), the independent Competent Person engaged to prepare the maiden JORC Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE"), has been closely involved in the programme to date, including supervising the drilling. The Company therefore expects to be well positioned to progress the MRE promptly once assays are received.

Ed Loye, CEO of Great Western, commented: "Identifying Starry Night, a historical mine adit west of Widowmaker, is another very encouraging development for Defender. It has the potential to extend our tungsten strike to around 2.4km and adds a further valuable data point along the trend towards our M2 resource. We intend to prioritise sampling at Starry Night, and the team are keen to get on site as soon as possible, whilst noting winter weather conditions.

"The delay to our drill assays is frustrating, but not unique to Great Western. Laboratory capacity constraints are affecting the industry across the region and are a symptom of the current buoyant mining landscape in Nevada. Addison has been closely involved since before drilling began, which puts us in a good position to move quickly once results are received. The assays and maiden resource are expected to give us a much fuller picture of our opportunity at Defender as we look towards mine development."

SHENZHEN, China, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- X Financial (NYSE: XYF), a leading Chinese fintech platform, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. This press release should be read in conjunction with the Company's Report on Form 6-K for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, which has been furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and is available on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov and on the Company's investor relations website at http://ir.xiaoyinggroup.com.

Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operational Highlights

  • Total net revenue in Q3 2026 was RMB771.5 million (US$115.1 million), a decrease of 60.7% year-over-year and 22.4% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year decline was mainly attributable to substantially lower loan facilitation volumes, which reduced loan facilitation service revenue and post-origination service revenue, as well as lower financing income.
  • Total loan amount facilitated and originated[1] in Q3 2026 was RMB4.35 billion, down 62.6% quarter-over-quarter and down 87.1% year-over-year.
  • Net loss in Q3 2026 was RMB159.6 million (US$23.8 million), compared with net income of RMB421.2 million a year ago and RMB47.0 million in Q2 2026, primarily reflecting income tax expense of RMB184.6 million and a loss from equity in affiliates, net of tax, of RMB70.9 million, which together exceeded income before income taxes of RMB101.9 million.
  • Delinquency rates for loans 31–60 days past due increased to 2.40% (from 1.73% at the end of Q2 2026 and 1.85% a year ago); loans 91–180 days past due declined to 7.83% (from 9.09% at the end of Q2 2026, though up from 3.52% a year ago). The 31–60 day delinquency rate increased both sequentially and year-over-year, indicating that credit trends deteriorated during the quarter, and the 91–180 day delinquency rate, while lower sequentially, remained materially above the prior-year level. During the quarter, the Company observed an increase in the 31–60 day delinquency rate, which may continue in the near term. The Company believes these trends are consistent with broader industry patterns.

Mr. Kent Li, President of X Financial, commented: "In the third quarter of 2026, we facilitated and originated RMB4.3 billion in loans, a decline of 62.6% from the prior quarter and 87.1% year-over-year. Borrower activity continued to contract, with active borrowers declining to approximately 290,269, down 88.1% from a year ago, while the average loan amount per transaction decreased 5.7% quarter-over-quarter to RMB11,983. The 31–60 day delinquency rate increased to 2.40% from 1.73% in the prior quarter, while the 91–180 day rate eased to 7.83% from 9.09%. The increase in the 31–60 day delinquency rate indicates that credit trends deteriorated during the quarter and may continue in the near term, and both delinquency rates remained above prior-year levels. We believe these trends are consistent with broader industry patterns. We therefore continue to prioritize disciplined underwriting, collection effectiveness, and conservative capital deployment. While the business remains under pressure from lower origination volumes and a challenging credit environment, our focus remains on preserving balance sheet resilience and operating flexibility."

Mr. Frank Fuya Zheng, Chief Financial Officer of X Financial, added: "In the third quarter of 2026, total net revenue was RMB771.5 million, a decrease of 60.7% from the same period last year and 22.4% sequentially. Net loss was RMB159.6 million and non-GAAP adjusted net loss was RMB152.2 million, compared with net income of RMB47.0 million and non-GAAP adjusted net income of RMB165.8 million in the prior quarter. Basic loss per ADS was RMB4.38, and non-GAAP adjusted basic loss per ADS was RMB4.14. Operating margin decreased to 11.8% from 19.6% in the prior quarter and from 18.5% in the same period of 2025. We will continue to manage capital conservatively, maintain cost discipline, and preserve liquidity as we navigate the evolving regulatory and operating environment."

Regulatory Update

The regulatory environment governing internet-based lending in the People's Republic of China continued to evolve during the third quarter of 2026, with authorities maintaining heightened oversight across the consumer credit business chain. The Company continues to monitor these developments closely; however, management has limited visibility into the ultimate scope and direction of implementation. If current and emerging regulatory requirements are implemented as currently understood, the Company's operating results may be materially and adversely affected, and historical levels of profitability should not be assumed to be indicative of future performance.

HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / EON Resources Inc. (NYSE American:EONR) ("EON" or the "Company") is an independent upstream energy company with 20,000 leasehold acres in the Permian Basin with approximately 1.2 billion barrels of original oil in place. Today, the Company announced that it reported a theft of property from the oil field to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force (the "NMOTTF") that led to arrests of several suspects.

On Saturday, November 21, 2026, at approximately 3:00 am, three suspects wearing dark masks, in a blue pickup, were caught on security cameras at the Grayburg-Jackson oil field in Eddy County, New Mexico owned and operated by LH Operating, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of EON. The suspects cut and stole copper wire critical to some of the field's operations.

"Each of the perpetrators were wearing masks, but the Company had good surveillance video including video of the pickup truck involved. All video and photographs were turned over to the SE New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force," said Dante Caravaggio, CEO of EON. EON also posted the same photographs on social media hoping someone would recognize and help identify the pickup and individuals. A Good Samaritan reported individuals and a vehicle matching the description from the surveillance footage. With the volunteered information turned over to the NMOTTF, the NMOTTF arrived at a residence where a truck was located fitting the description of the truck used in the theft and arrests were made.

According to authorities, a significant amount of copper wire was identified at the residence. The copper wire had been stripped of its insulation.

The NMOTTF moved quickly to identify alleged participants within two days of the theft. Limited production in the field was partially interrupted for 3 days until new wire could be procured and installed on a fast-track basis.

"We are thrilled to have reported the theft directly to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force who were incredible. We hope cameras and quick action, as was the case this time, help all operators bring down costs, downtime, and losses from criminal activity that hurts everyone," stated Dante Caravaggio.

About EON Resources Inc.

EON is an independent upstream energy company focused on maximizing total returns to shareholders through the development of onshore oil and natural gas properties. EON's Class A Common Stock trades on the NYSE American under "EONR," and its public warrants trade under "EONR WS." For more information on the Company, please visit the EON website.

Two Permian Basin Assets, Multiple Development Horizons

Grayburg-Jackson Field (GJF): 13,700 contiguous leasehold acres in Eddy County, New Mexico, with stacked pay zones and almost 1 billion barrels of estimated original oil in place, of which less than 7% has been produced to date. The San Andres horizontal development program commenced in August 2026.

South Justis Unit (SJU): 5,360 contiguous acres in Lea County, New Mexico, with approximately 207 million barrels of original oil in place. EON's geologic and reservoir work on the Blinebry zone indicates development potential that management believes is similar in character to the opportunity identified in the GJF.

ATLANTA & ZUG, Switzerland--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The Coca-Cola Company and Gutsche Family Investments (GFI) have completed the sale of a 75% controlling interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa Pty. Ltd. (CCBA) to Coca-Cola HBC AG.

The proposed transaction was first announced in October 2025. The companies closed on Nov. 27 after receiving all necessary regulatory approvals in Africa.

Coca-Cola and Coca-Cola HBC have a separate option agreement providing Coca-Cola HBC the opportunity to acquire the remaining 25% stake in CCBA held by Coca-Cola within a six-year period.

CCBA is the largest Coca-Cola bottler in Africa, operating in 14 countries. Following completion of the deal, Coca-Cola HBC is the second-largest Coca-Cola bottler globally by volume, extending its footprint to 43 markets and serving approximately 1.2 billion consumers across Europe and Africa.

Advancing Coca-Cola's Refranchising Strategy

The completion of the transaction marks another significant milestone in Coca-Cola's ongoing strategy to refranchise company-owned and controlled bottling operations.

“This transaction reflects the strength of the Coca-Cola system and our long-term commitment to building locally led, world-class bottling operations,” said Henrique Braun, CEO of The Coca-Cola Company. “CCBA has established a strong foundation across Africa, and Coca-Cola HBC brings proven capabilities, deep market expertise and a successful track record of investing for sustainable growth.”

Luis Felipe Avellar, president of the Africa operating unit of The Coca Cola Company, said, “We are confident this combination will create new opportunities for customers, consumers and communities across the continent. Coca-Cola HBC is a strong, valued partner that has the ability to grow our business in Africa.”

The Gutsche family will remain connected to the Coca-Cola system and Africa through its ownership stake in Coca-Cola HBC.

Strengthening Coca-Cola HBC’s Presence in Africa

The acquisition builds on Coca-Cola HBC’s origins in Nigeria 75 years ago and its expansion into Egypt in 2022. Following completion of the acquisition, Coca-Cola HBC now represents approximately two-thirds of Africa’s total Coca-Cola system volume and serves more than half of the continent’s population. The combination creates a stronger platform to share capabilities, invest in people and infrastructure, and drive sustainable, profitable growth.

Zoran Bogdanovic, CEO of Coca-Cola HBC, said: “Today we mark a historic milestone as we complete the acquisition of CCBA. Africa is where Coca-Cola HBC began 75 years ago, and this acquisition significantly strengthens our presence across this incredible continent, creating a strong platform for sustainable, profitable growth. Our listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange this week further underlines our long-term commitment to South Africa and the broader African continent.

“CCBA is a high-quality business with strong market positions, deep local knowledge and talented people. We are very pleased to welcome our new colleagues to Coca-Cola HBC. Together, we will invest in our leading 24/7 portfolio, our bespoke capabilities and our passionate people to capture the significant opportunities ahead.

“I would like to thank The Coca-Cola Company and the Gutsche family for their trust and partnership, and our teams across CCBA, Coca-Cola HBC and the wider Coca-Cola system for their commitment in completing this transaction. We look forward to working together to drive joint success.”

As part of the transaction, Coca-Cola sold 41.52% of its 66.52% stake in CCBA to Coca-Cola HBC, while Coca-Cola HBC acquired the 33.48% stake held by GFI.

Rothschild & Co. acted as sole financial adviser to Coca-Cola. Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE, Amsterdam Branch and UBS AG London Branch acted as financial advisers to Coca-Cola HBC. Nomura International acted as sole financial adviser to GFI.

About The Coca-Cola Company

The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE: KO) is a total beverage company with products sold in more than 200 countries and territories. Our company’s purpose is to refresh the world and make a difference. We sell multiple billion-dollar brands across several beverage categories worldwide. Our portfolio of sparkling soft drink brands includes Coca-Cola, Sprite and Fanta. Our water, sports, coffee and tea brands include Dasani, smartwater, vitaminwater, Topo Chico, BODYARMOR, Powerade, Costa, Georgia, Fuze Tea, Gold Peak and Ayataka. Our juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverage brands include Minute Maid, Simply, innocent, Del Valle, fairlife and Santa Clara. We’re constantly transforming our portfolio, from reducing sugar in our drinks to bringing innovative new products to market. We seek to positively impact people’s lives, communities and the planet through water replenishment, packaging recycling, sustainable sourcing practices and carbon emissions reductions across our value chain. Together with our bottling partners, we employ more than 700,000 people, helping bring economic opportunity to local communities worldwide. Learn more at www.coca-colacompany.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

About Coca-Cola HBC AG

Coca-Cola HBC is a growth-focused consumer packaged goods business and strategic bottling partner of The Coca-Cola Company. Our business was founded in Nigeria in 1951, and this year we celebrate our 75th anniversary. We open up moments that refresh us all, by creating value for our stakeholders and supporting the socio-economic development of the communities in which we operate. With a vision to be the leading 24/7 beverage partner, we offer drinks for all occasions around the clock. Following the completion of our acquisition of a majority stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa on 27 November 2026, we work together with our customers to serve more than 1.2 billion consumers across 43 markets in Europe and Africa.

Our portfolio is one of the strongest, broadest and most flexible in the beverage industry, with consumer-leading brands across the sparkling, adult sparkling, juice, water, sport, energy, ready-to-drink tea, coffee, and premium spirits categories, with snacks as an additional offering. Our products include Coca-Cola, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Fanta, Sprite, Schweppes, Kinley, Costa Coffee, Caffè Vergnano, Valser, Romerquelle, Dasani and other water brands, FuzeTea, Powerade, Cappy, Monster Energy, Finlandia Vodka, The Macallan, Jack Daniel's and Plazma. We foster an open and inclusive work environment for approximately 50,000 employees and believe that a positive environmental impact is integral to our future growth. We are among the leaders of the global beverage industry across major sustainability benchmarks, including the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Indices, CDP, MSCI ESG, FTSE ESG and ISS ESG.

Coca-Cola HBC is listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: CCH), Euronext Athens (Euronext Athens: EEE) and the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE: CHB). For more information, please visit https://www.coca-colahellenic.com

SINGAPORE, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. This expansion marks a significant milestone in the company's global growth strategy, bringing its novel, globally standardized “condotel” business model to one of India’s fastest-growing technology and business hubs.

The joint venture partner for Hotel101-Hyderabad is Pooja Crafted Homes (“PCH”), a Hyderabad-based developer founded in 2001 that has developed residential and commercial projects totaling more than 5.5 million square feet. Introduced and facilitated by CBRE India, the partnership pairs PCH’s local development experience with Hotel101 Global’s platform. PCH is also developing one of Hyderabad’s first luxury mixed-use developments that may include a JW Marriott-branded hotel and branded residences.

Hotel101 Global Team believes it ensures all its projects via direct developments, joint ventures and licensing to local developers in various countries worldwide are in prime and strategic locations.

Hotel101-Hyderabad is planned to occupy the top 7 floors of The Harvest Building, a premium Grade-A commercial development in Kokapet. This strategic high-rise positioning is expected to offer guests breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding landscape, including Kokapet Lake and the vibrant western corridor skyline. Kokapet has rapidly emerged as one of Hyderabad’s premier luxury and investment destinations, known for its modern infrastructure, upscale developments, and seamless blend of residential, commercial, and recreational spaces.

Key Location Advantages:

  • Prime Western Corridor Position: Located in Kokapet, directly adjacent to the Financial District and just minutes from Gachibowli and HITEC City. Upon completion, guests are expected to benefit from excellent connectivity via the Outer Ring Road (“ORR”), upcoming metro expansions, and proximity to major IT hubs housing global companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and Infosys.
  • Proximity to Business and Employment Hubs: Ideal for business travelers and corporate guests, with immediate access to Hyderabad’s booming Financial District, IT parks, and commercial centers. Hotel101 Global believes the area’s strong job market and high demand for quality accommodation drive consistent occupancy potential.
  • Lifestyle and Leisure Appeal: Surrounded by modern amenities including premium malls (such as Kokapet One), restaurants, green spaces, and natural attractions like Khajaguda Hills. The location is expected to offer the balance of urban convenience and serene surroundings, providing leisure travelers with easy access to Hyderabad’s renowned heritage sites, including Charminar and Golconda Fort, along with its dynamic cultural attractions.
  • Investment and Growth Potential: Kokapet is one of Hyderabad’s most active real estate markets, benefiting from gated communities, world-class infrastructure, high rental demand, and strong appreciation driven by IT sector growth and premium developments.

When completed, Hotel101-Hyderabad is expected to have a project value of approx. ₹5.95 billion (US$64.4 million) and is expected to be the largest hotel by room count in Hyderabad, India, forming part of Hotel101 Global’s global expansion strategy.

Hotel101-Hyderabad is expected to offer 4-star amenities at affordable prices, featuring breathtaking views from its elevated floors, swimming pools, all-day dining, a modern fitness center, function rooms, a business center, a convenience store, and approx. 625 signature HappyRooms. Consistent with Hotel101’s offerings across its locations globally, guests are expected to enjoy modern, tech-enabled rooms, 24/7 reception, and a range of lifestyle amenities tailored for both business and leisure travelers.

The development forms part of Hotel101 Global’s global expansion strategy through joint ventures with local partners and is subject to customary governmental, regulatory, corporate and other approvals.

Listed on Nasdaq (Ticker: HBNB) with a market capitalization of approx. US$1 billion as of November 26, 2026, Hotel101 is an asset-light, prop-tech hospitality platform pioneering a globally standardized “condotel” business model. TAICHUNG, Taiwan, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd (NASDAQ: AGCC) ("Agencia" or the "Company") today provided an update on its AI computing and data center business and reaffirmed its commitment to compliance with the applicable laws and regulations governing its business. The Company also clarified certain matters referred to in a media report published on November 25, 2026 (the "Report"). The Report does not allege that the Company has breached any law or regulation.

Expanding From Whisky Into AI Computing Infrastructure and Data Center Operations

Agencia listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market in October 2025 as an importer and distributor of whisky, a business that it continues to operate. In reviewing opportunities for growth beyond whisky, the Board of Directors identified strong demand for AI computing capacity and data centers in Southeast Asia, a region in which the Company and its management have established business relationships. Southeast Asia has attracted substantial data center investment from international operators, supported by the availability of land and power at competitive cost. The Company believes that this market offers long-term growth opportunities.

To develop that opportunity, the Board appointed Mr. Li Qiang as Chairman on December 11, 2025. Mr. Li has more than 20 years of experience in the data center and technology infrastructure industry, and he oversees the development of the Company's data center business.

Since announcing its AI computing strategy in February 2026, Agencia has been developing its data center and AI computing business and, directly or through its subsidiaries, has entered into a number of agreements for that purpose, as disclosed in its reports filed with or furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The Company expects to begin providing AI computing services once the computing capacity it has contracted from its provider is in place, subject to and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Like other companies listed in the United States, Agencia aims to build long-term value for its shareholders, and it will continue to evaluate opportunities that can do so within applicable laws and regulations.

Commitment to Compliance

Agencia is committed to conducting its business in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including the export control laws and regulations of the United States. The Company has not sold or supplied any product or service to any party in breach of the export control laws of the United States or of any other jurisdiction, and it has no intention of doing so.

Under the Company's computing capacity agreement, the provider warrants that the equipment used to provide the services is sourced through authorized sales channels and is exported and imported in compliance with applicable export control laws.

On November 19, 2026, the Bureau of Industry and Security of the U.S. Department of Commerce ("BIS") published an interim final rule on remote access to advanced semiconductors. The rule introduces new requirements that may apply to the Company's computing capacity and customer arrangements. Those requirements, and the steps that manufacturers and suppliers are taking in response to them, may affect those arrangements, including their timing. The Company is reviewing the rule, and its supplier and customer arrangements, with its advisers. It is committed to complying with all applicable rules and regulations and will provide services only as they permit.

Clarification Regarding Recent Media Report

The Company wishes to clarify two matters referred to in the Report.

The Company's business. The Company is not a seller or reseller of semiconductor chips or hardware. Agencia's data center business is a services business comprising two service lines: data center colocation services, which will provide space, power and connectivity for customers’ own equipment, and AI computing services, in which the Company contracts for computing capacity to provide AI computing cloud services to its customers. No AI semiconductors, hardware or servers are, or are planned to be, sold, delivered or transferred to any customer in either service line.

Relevant entities highlighted in the Report. The Report describes Yuxing InfoTech Investment Holdings Limited ("Yuxing InfoTech") as the parent company of Ricloud AI Inc. ("Ricloud AI"). The document that the Report cites for that statement, the 2025 annual report of Yuxing InfoTech, lists Ricloud Corp. as a subsidiary of Yuxing InfoTech. It does not list Ricloud AI as a subsidiary. Ricloud Corp. and Ricloud AI are separate legal entities.

The Company's related party relationships and transactions are disclosed in its filings with the SEC, including its prospectus filed on July 20, 2026. Mr. Li's positions with Yuxing InfoTech and with Ricloud AI are described in that prospectus.

"Agencia began as a small whisky business, and we are building a second business in data center and AI computing infrastructure because we see a real opportunity to create value for our shareholders," said Mr. LIU Shihao, Chief Financial Officer of Agencia. "Our focus is on disciplined execution and on building this business transparently and in compliance with the laws of the United States and of every country in which we operate." 

About Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd

Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd is a Nasdaq-listed company with two principal business focuses: (i) its established premium whisky operations; and (ii) the development of data center and AI computing infrastructure, including data center colocation services and cloud-based AI computing services.

Since early 2026, the Company has launched and been developing its AI Computing Infrastructure Initiative, covering data center colocation and AI cloud computing services through subsidiaries in Singapore, Indonesia and other jurisdictions. This initiative represents a principal business focus, backed by substantive contractual arrangements for commercial AI computing cloud services and the development of supporting data center, power, network and technical infrastructure. The Company’s historical operating revenue has been derived from its whisky operations, and the data center and AI computing business remain in development and deployment and is subject to significant business, financing, construction, technology, regulatory, customer demand and execution risks.
